title: Office application spawned an encoded PowerShell command
description: OUTLOOK.EXE on WKS-HR-014 started powershell.exe with -nop -w hidden -enc. The command line is base64-encoded and the window was hidden. No business process on this endpoint has done this before.

title: User-reported suspicious email (payroll theme)
description: An HR officer reported an urgent payroll email and raised ticket SD-88214. The gateway delivered the message with SPF and DMARC both failing. The user says they opened the attachment.

title: Potentially unwanted program quarantined
description: FreePDFToolbar.exe was quarantined on WKS-HR-015 before execution. Adware bundle, already contained by the endpoint agent.

title: Inbound connection attempts denied at perimeter
description: Routine internet background noise against the perimeter address. All attempts denied by the default-deny inbound policy. No action required.

title: Repeating outbound connections to a newly registered domain
description: WKS-HR-014 has resolved update-cdn.paylo4d.example every 60 seconds with near-identical request sizes. The domain was registered six days ago. This is command-and-control beaconing, not browsing.

title: Run key created pointing at an unsigned binary in AppData
description: A HKCU Run value named OneDriveSync now points at an unsigned executable under AppData\Roaming. The name imitates a Microsoft component. This survives reboot and re-runs at every logon.
